verdict.rationale: Bolt's own docs say the platform can check a project for security problems and fix what it finds, which is a direct first-party security review capability. The evidence is a single thin mention, though. Nothing ties the check to the publish or go-live step, and nothing describes what it covers (backend, database, auth rules) or how deep it goes. missing for 10: documented pre-publish/pre-deploy security gating, details on scan scope (backend/data, auth, secrets, dependencies), description of findings/report output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live

citations.quote: Bolt can check your project for security problems and fix what it finds.
